# 10 - バッチ完了サマリを Teams カードで通知（3色分岐）
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# excel dep-batch の集計結果を1枚のカードにまとめて投稿する。
#   全件成功 → style:"good"（緑帯）
#   一部エラー → style:"warning"（黄帯）
#   起動失敗   → style:"attention"（赤帯）
# 06/07 の夜間バッチの末尾に繋げて「朝 Teams を見れば結果が分かる」
# 運用に使う雛形。
# ============================================================
SET ExePath TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc\\fincalc.exe'''
SET WorkDir TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc'''
SET WebhookUrl TO $'''https://example.webhook.office.com/webhookb2/xxxxx'''
SET InputXlsx TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc\\in\\assets.xlsx'''
SET OutputXlsx TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc\\out\\dep_result.xlsx'''


SET JobName TO $'''資産台帳 一括償却バッチ'''

# --- バッチ実行（Excel 不要、exe が直接 xlsx を読み書き） ---
# CLI を実行し stdout/stderr/exit code を CliOut/CliErr/CliExit へ格納
Scripting.RunDOSCommand.RunDOSCommand DOSCommandOrApplication: $'''%ExePath% excel dep-batch --input "%InputXlsx%" --sheet "*" --output "%OutputXlsx%"''' WorkingDirectory: WorkDir StandardOutput=> CliOut StandardError=> CliErr ExitCode=> CliExit

DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> Now

IF CliExit = 0 THEN
    # stdout の JSON をカスタムオブジェクトへ変換
    Variables.ConvertJsonToCustomObject Json: CliOut CustomObject=> Batch
    IF Batch.errorCount > 0 THEN
        SET Body TO $'''{"type":"message","attachments":[{"contentType":"application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive","content":{"type":"AdaptiveCard","$schema":"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json","version":"1.4","body":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"%JobName% : 一部エラー","weight":"bolder","size":"medium","color":"warning"},{"type":"FactSet","facts":[{"title":"成功","value":"%Batch.okCount% 件"},{"title":"エラー","value":"%Batch.errorCount% 件"},{"title":"出力","value":"out/dep_result.xlsx"},{"title":"時刻","value":"%Now%"}]},{"type":"Container","style":"warning","items":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"エラー行は summary シートの error 列を確認してください","wrap":true}]}]}}]}'''
    ELSE
        SET Body TO $'''{"type":"message","attachments":[{"contentType":"application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive","content":{"type":"AdaptiveCard","$schema":"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json","version":"1.4","body":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"%JobName% : 完了","weight":"bolder","size":"medium"},{"type":"FactSet","facts":[{"title":"処理件数","value":"%Batch.okCount% 件"},{"title":"出力","value":"out/dep_result.xlsx"},{"title":"時刻","value":"%Now%"}]},{"type":"Container","style":"good","items":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"全資産の償却計算が完了しました","wrap":true}]}]}}]}'''
    END
ELSE
    SET Body TO $'''{"type":"message","attachments":[{"contentType":"application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive","content":{"type":"AdaptiveCard","$schema":"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json","version":"1.4","body":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"%JobName% : 起動失敗","weight":"bolder","size":"medium","color":"attention"},{"type":"FactSet","facts":[{"title":"終了コード","value":"%CliExit%"},{"title":"時刻","value":"%Now%"}]},{"type":"Container","style":"attention","items":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"exe が起動できませんでした。パスと引数を確認してください","wrap":true}]}]}}]}'''
END

# Teams Webhook へ Adaptive Card JSON を POST (応答は HTTP 202)
Web.InvokeWebService.InvokeWebService Url: WebhookUrl Method: Web.Method.Post Accept: $'''application/json''' ContentType: $'''application/json''' RequestBody: Body EncodeRequestBody: False TrimRequestBody: True ClearCookies: True FailOnErrorStatus: False FollowRedirection: True UserAgent: $'''Mozilla/5.0''' ConnectionTimeout: 30 AcceptUntrustedCertificates: False Response=> WebResponse ResponseHeaders=> WebHeaders StatusCode=> WebStatus

IF (WebStatus < 200) OR (WebStatus > 299) THEN
    # 警告ダイアログを表示 (Timeout 秒で自動的に閉じる)
    Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessageWithTimeout Title: $'''Teams 通知失敗''' Message: $'''HTTP %WebStatus% : %WebResponse%''' Icon: Display.Icon.Warning Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False Timeout: 30
    EXIT
END

# 情報ダイアログを表示 (Timeout 秒で自動的に閉じる)
Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessageWithTimeout Title: $'''完了''' Message: $'''バッチ結果を Teams に投稿しました''' Icon: Display.Icon.Information Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False Timeout: 10
